-module(solution).
-export([start/0]).

start() ->
    case gen_tcp:connect({93,184,216,34}, 80, [{active, false}, {packet, 0}], 3000) of
        {ok, Sock} ->
            io:format("connected!~n"),
            gen_tcp:close(Sock);
        {error, Reason} ->
            io:format("error: ~p~n", [Reason])
    end.
